publicationMetadataPlan.creator: OpenAI built-in image generation
publicationMetadataPlan.mediaDescription: Review-only scientific algorithmic anatomical or condition reconstruction, not a photograph, scan, histology slide, patient record, or diagnostic image
publicationMetadataPlan.sourceUse: NLM MeSH supplies controlled condition identity and scope; official NIH or CDC sources constrain conservative representation. No source composition is copied.

reviewStandard: Current controlled condition identity, conservative non-diagnostic anatomy or system orientation, non-stigmatizing communication, pale edge field, crop-safe geometry, and exact prompt frozen before exactly one generation call per cleared route. Every PNG was inspected at native 1536 by 1024 resolution; observed output controls later metadata.
promotionRule: Only exact source hashes separately accepted by Control Tower may be promoted.
